title: Research: PIV wrong error code for malloc failure (WP11_PIV_ERR_PARAM)
description:
In wp11_proto_piv.c lines 639 and 971, when malloc() fails the functions return WP11_PIV_ERR_PARAM. This error code means 'bad argument' to all callers. An OOM failure is reported identically to a programming error, so callers cannot distinguish resource exhaustion from bugs and may retry with identical inputs.

Research: trace all callers of wp11_piv_get_cert() and wp11_piv_attest() to understand what they do with WP11_PIV_ERR_PARAM. Determine whether adding WP11_PIV_ERR_NOMEM to the error enum is the right fix or if returning WP11_PIV_ERR_TRANSPORT is sufficient. Then fix and add comment.
